name: Whisper Thread
description: Cast a fine thread of soul force round an opponent's soul so that its next move comes slow.

name: Snagging Knot
description: Tie a knot of soul force before the user's chest so that a soul-strike snags and spends itself in it.

name: Quick Hitch
description: Hitch the thread to a nearby soul and let the draw of it pull the user a pace in.

name: Feeling Strand
description: Lay a strand across a soul and feel through it how tense the soul is.

name: Light Snare
description: Lay a light snare across an opponent's technique as it forms so that the technique stumbles.

name: Tightening Cord
description: Draw a cord round an opponent's soul and tighten it a little at a time.

name: Soul Tether
description: Cast a tether from the user's soul to an opponent's and hold it so that the opponent cannot easily range away.

name: Slackened Tether
description: Let the tether go slack at the moment of a soul-strike so that the strike slides along the line and off.

name: Reeling Pull
description: Reel in the tether and ride the pull a stride toward the soul on its other end.

name: Tension Reading
description: Feel the tether grow taut and read from the strain what the other soul means to do.

name: Snapping Lead
description: Snap the free end of the tether against an opponent's soul so that a sharp sting follows.

name: Tangle Snag
description: Snag the tether in an opponent's forming technique and tangle it before it is loosed.

name: Drawn Cord
description: Draw a cord across the gap and pull it snug on an opponent's technique so that it comes out weak.

name: Cord Sheath
description: Wrap the cord round the user's soul in layers that dull a soul-strike.

name: Cord Step
description: Fix the cord's end on a far soul and step along it to the other end.

name: Testing Tug
description: Tug the cord once and read from the answering pull how firmly a soul stands.

name: Biting Loop
description: Close a loop on an opponent's soul so that it bites in sharply as it tightens.

name: Fouled Tether
description: Foul the line between an opponent and a target so that the opponent's soul-technique cannot reach it cleanly.

name: Dragging Weight
description: Hang a dragging weight on the cord so that an opponent's soul moves as if through mud.

name: Light Fetter
description: Close a plain fetter on one limb of an opponent's intent so that one gesture fails for a breath.

name: Fetter Plate
description: Beat the fetter flat into a plate that stands against a thin soul-lash.

name: Stubby Chain
description: Throw a short chain to a far soul and let it haul the user across in one step.

name: Weighing Link
description: Set a link on a soul and weigh how much strain it will bear.

name: Gyve Bite
description: Snap a gyve round an opponent's soul so that it bites before the opponent notes it.

name: Hasp Close
description: Close a hasp on an opponent's technique so that it cannot open for a heartbeat.

name: Slack Noose
description: Lay a noose slack round an opponent's soul so that it cinches only when the opponent pulls against it.

name: Loose Coil
description: Hold a loose coil before the user that gives under a soul-strike and takes its force.

name: Noose Slip
description: Slip free of a hostile noose and step out of its reach.

name: Cinching Strike
description: Cinch the noose with a hard pull so that the opponent's soul takes a sudden squeeze.

name: Resting Loop
description: Rest a loop on a soul and feel it move against the loop whenever it stirs.

name: Clinging Thread
description: Lay a clinging thread on an opponent's soul that follows it wherever it moves and drags at its pace.

name: Shed Strand
description: Shed a loose strand over a soul-bolt so that the bolt winds away from the user.

name: Following Slack
description: Pay out slack along the thread and move on after the soul that carries the other end.

name: Tracing Strand
description: Read the trail that the thread draws behind a fleeing soul and tell where it ran.

name: Prickling Barb
description: Set a barb in the clinging thread so that it pricks the soul with each pull.

name: Muting Wrap
description: Wrap the thread once round an opponent's technique and mute its first flare.
